stories.title: São Paulo segue em alerta de perigo para tempestades neste domingo; veja previsão

en.title: São Paulo remains on storm danger alert this Sunday; see forecast
en.summary: São Paulo state is under alert for dangerous storm conditions on Sunday.

stories.title: São Paulo segue em alerta de perigo para tempestades neste domingo (13)

en.title: São Paulo remains on alert for storms this Sunday (13)
en.summary: Weather instability affecting São Paulo state is expected to continue on Sunday, following Saturday's storms that caused disappearances and flooding.

stories.title: Confira a partir das 11h deste domingo (13) o resultado do concurso 3057 da Mega-Sena

en.title: Check the result of Mega-Sena draw 3057 from 11am this Sunday (13)
en.summary: The Mega-Sena lottery draw 3057 will be held on Sunday at 11am, with the main prize estimated at 85 million reais.

stories.title: Enamed será aplicado neste domingo; veja regras para estudantes de medicina

en.title: Enamed will be administered this Sunday; see rules for medical students
en.summary: Medical students across Brazil will take the Enamed national assessment exam on Sunday, which is mandatory for those completing their degrees and certain fourth-year students meeting criteria set by the education institute.

stories.title: Trens da linha 7-rubi vão funcionar com lentidão neste domingo (13) para retirada árvore dos trilhos

en.title: Line 7-rubi trains will operate slowly on Sunday (13) to remove tree from tracks
en.summary: The ruby line will operate with reduced speed and longer intervals on Sunday to remove a large tree that fell onto the tracks near Pirituba station in northern São Paulo.

stories.title: Mega-Sena sorteia prêmio acumulado de R$ 85 milhões neste domingo

en.title: Mega-Sena draws accumulated prize of R$ 85 million this Sunday
en.summary: Brazil's Mega-Sena lottery will draw an estimated R$ 85 million prize on Sunday, with ticket sales closing Saturday at 10 p.m. Brasília time. A simple six-number bet costs R$ 6.
